```yaml
name: Remote Access Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        rust-version: [1.85.0, stable]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust ${{ matrix.rust-version }}
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust-version }}
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          cache: true

      - name: Cache Cargo registry and target
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.rust-version }}
          shared-key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-shared
          workspaces: ./

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all --check

      - name: Build workspace (all features)
        run: cargo build --workspace --all-features

      - name: Build workspace (no default features)
        run: cargo build --workspace --no-default-features

      - name: Build examples (all features)
        run: cargo build --examples --all-features

      - name: Run tests (workspace, all features)
        run: cargo test --workspace --all-features

      - name: Run tests (workspace, no default features)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features

      - name: Run tests (examples, all features)
        run: cargo test --examples --all-features

      - name: Run tests (examples, no default features)
        run: cargo test --examples --no-default-features

      - name: Run clippy (workspace, all features)
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Run clippy (workspace, no default features)
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --no-default-features -- -D warnings
```
